title: Work Journal suggestions: tick boxes, select all, and Accept or Reject all or only the ticked ones
summary: The Work Journal Suggestions box gains a tick box per suggestion, a select-all box, and Accept all / Reject all (Accept N / Reject N when ticked), running each item through the single Accept or Reject so its safety checks hold and one failure never stops the rest.
friction: The dev agent's gate was killed for low memory a second time, because its own earlier Vitest run was still alive in the background while it built; the brief now says to confirm no earlier run is alive before the next step
lessons_learned: Tell dev agents to run each gate command in the foreground and check no earlier run from their worktree is still alive; a backgrounded Vitest plus a build exhausts the 7.8 GB machine

deferred.what: The effect in WorkJournalEditor.tsx around line 307 that restores the stored body can run in the middle of a card insert through Tiptap's flushSync, so a later change that writes the stored body just before an append would silently lose a card while Accept reports it saved (today only reproducible under act())
deferred.why: No user path triggers it today; hardening it is a design change to the editor sync
